variants.title: Michelson interferometer: wavelength of a green DPSS laser
variants.unknown: the wavelength of the green laser
variants.note: A frequency-doubled Nd:YAG laser: 1064 nm halved to 532 nm. The shorter wavelength gives more fringes for the same travel.
